question: The emergent ray from the optical centre of the lens will be _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**un-deviated**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **emergent ray from the optical center of a lens will be un-deviated**.
 
• This means **that the ray will pass through the lens without changing direction. **
 
• The **optical center is the center of the lens.** 
 
• A ray of light passing through the optical center of a lens will emerge without any deviation after refraction. 
 
• This means that the path of the ray will not change

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __CONCEPT__:
